kindHint.timed_price: A lower unit price for up to 30 days. A 14-day gap is needed before the next one.
kindHint.volume_tiers: Lower unit prices as the order quantity grows (up to 5 tiers).
kindHint.free_delivery_moq: Free delivery above a quantity or order value, optionally for chosen regions.

page.title: Offers
page.description: Volume pricing, limited-time prices and free delivery on your live listings. Honest by design: buyers only ever see a real 30-day comparison.
page.howBody: If your offer is below the lowest price your listing had in the last 30 days, buyers see that price struck through, labelled as such, with the percentage rounded down. We work it out from your price history, so raising a price before a sale does not create a bigger discount. Offers end exactly when they say they do.
page.paused: Offers are paused on your account after buyer reports that were upheld. Contact support to have this reviewed.
page.emptyDesc: Create your first offer above. Offers help buyers choose you at larger quantities.
page.refSeen: Buyers see <money></money> struck through, the lowest price of the last 30 days.
page.refSeenPct: Buyers see <money></money> struck through, {pct}% below, the lowest price of the last 30 days.
page.noRef: Buyers see your offer price only (not enough price history for a comparison).

form.noListings: Publish a listing with a price first. Offers run on live listings.
form.refWith: Buyers compare your offer with {price}, the lowest price this listing had in the last 30 days. We work this out from your price history. You cannot type it.
form.noHistory: This listing does not have 30 days of price history yet, so buyers will see your offer price only, with no “was” price and no percentage.
form.priceHint: Must be at least 3% below your lowest price of the last 30 days.
form.tiersHelp: Quantities must grow and prices must fall. The first tier starts at or above your minimum order.
form.regionsHint: e.g. Karnataka, Tamil Nadu. Leave empty for all of India.
form.honour: You must honour this offer for enquiries that meet its terms. Buyers can report an offer that was not honoured, and repeated upheld reports pause offers on your account. Offers never change your search ranking.
form.okReview: Your offer is with our team for a quick check (it is a large discount or needs a second look). We will notify you.
form.okScheduled: Your offer is scheduled and starts automatically.

errors.addTier: Add at least one price tier.
